beginner.title: Get started with Supabase
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Supabase, find your way around and finish a first small task

beginner.title: Install and run

beginner.title: Core workflow
beginner.outcome: You can: do the everyday task Supabase is for

intermediate.title: Debug and test
intermediate.outcome: You can: find and prevent problems

intermediate.title: Work in a team
intermediate.outcome: You can: use Supabase in shared projects

intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Supabase distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Supabase
expert.outcome: You can: use Supabase's advanced capabilities with confidence

expert.title: Production-ready
expert.outcome: You can: run Supabase reliably in production
expert.practice: Add Supabase to a CI pipeline with checks

expert.title: Integrate Supabase into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Supabase with the other tools you use

expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Supabase well
